mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 70 degrees. The moon is in its third quarter, and we expect an overnight low of 64 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona now manages the Verona Cemetery at 565 North Main Street. Anyone can purchase a plot, though specific rules apply for monument sizes and decorations. Additionally, the city offers a rain barrel rebate program to help residents reduce stormwater runoff by providing a credit for qualifying barrel installations.

We have plenty happening in town. Yoga at Insight Wellness is today. Tomorrow, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus Brewing or the Quizmasters event at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, we have a variety of events on August 5 including trivia at Paddy Mac's, the Farmer's Market, and more.
In a report from the past week, on July 31, an officer stopped a vehicle for an equipment violation and ended up arresting the driver for O W I and citing her for a prohibited alcohol concentration.

Today's Flavor of the Day is the delicious Chocolate Covered Strawberry. Since the store is currently closed, you can look forward to stopping by when they open tomorrow at 10:00 AM, when the flavor will be Butter Pecan.
